json_ld.description:
Cocoon in the warmth of real wool—then take flight, you beautiful butterfly, you… Indeed, wool fleece hits different. Unlike traditional fleece made from plastic, our Woolaroo Cocoon Jacket is woven from luxurious all-natural wool yarn, giving you easy, wear-anywhere warmth for all your travels.

A collarless jacket with feminine lines, designed with a soft cocoon silhouette and blouson sleeves, the Woolaroo Cocoon Jacket is roomy enough to layer, keeping you warm when the breeze picks up, while nice and breathable, thanks to its natural fibers.

We’re proud of our new natural wool fleece hoodie that's breathable, odor-resistant, and quick-drying.

And yes, while wool does shed, it’s a natural fiber that will break down rather than contribute to the plastic pollution problem.
  • Sorted, recycled, spun, and woven in Italy, our partner Manteco created a plush fabric that is made completely of recycled wool, helping to divert pre- and post-consumer virgin wool textiles from landfills and putting this valuable fiber back into circulation.
  • The color in this garment is made from combining recycled pre- and post-consumer waste, which helps to spare the use of any additional water or dyestuffs.
  • Details include natural corozo nut buttons, hidden on-seam zip pockets, and delicate braided trim. Fully lined with 100% organic cotton for comfort you can feel good about.
  • OK logo embroidery above cuff.

Cocoon in the warmth of real wool—then take flight, you beautiful butterfly, you… Indeed, wool fleece hits different. Unlike traditional fleece made from plastic, our Woolaroo Cocoon Jacket is woven from luxurious all-natural wool yarn, giving you easy, wear-anywhere warmth for all your travels.

A collarless jacket with feminine lines, designed with a soft cocoon silhouette and blouson sleeves, the Woolaroo Cocoon Jacket is roomy enough to layer, keeping you warm when the breeze picks up, while nice and breathable, thanks to its natural fibers.

We’re proud of our new natural wool fleece hoodie that's breathable, odor-resistant, and quick-drying.

And yes, while wool does shed, it’s a natural fiber that will break down rather than contribute to the plastic pollution problem.
  • Sorted, recycled, spun, and woven in Italy, our partner Manteco created a plush fabric that is made completely of recycled wool, helping to divert pre- and post-consumer virgin wool textiles from landfills and putting this valuable fiber back into circulation.
  • The color in this garment is made from combining recycled pre- and post-consumer waste, which helps to spare the use of any additional water or dyestuffs.
  • Details include natural corozo nut buttons, hidden on-seam zip pockets, and delicate braided trim. Fully lined with 100% organic cotton for comfort you can feel good about.
  • OK logo embroidery above cuff.
